description: AML alerts for a transaction and the account's recent activity; the application sums the scores and passes them to aml_alert_action. Amounts in VND; thresholds are invented for illustration

rules.description: Cash deposit or withdrawal at or above the (invented) reporting threshold of 300,000,000 VND
3 or more cash deposits in 7 days, each from 80% of the reporting threshold up to just below it; history includes this transaction
rules.when: history.cashDepositsLast7d.filter(d, d >= money(300000000, 'VND') * decimal('0.8') && d < money(300000000, 'VND')).size() >= 3

rules.description: Money out within 24 hours is 90% or more of money in, above a minimum inflow of 500,000,000 VND (100,000,000 VND for high-risk customers)
rules.when: history.totalInLast24h >= (account.riskRating == 'HIGH' ? money(100000000, 'VND') : money(500000000, 'VND')) && history.totalOutLast24h >= history.totalInLast24h * decimal('0.9')

rules.description: Counterparty in a high-risk jurisdiction; XA, XB and XC are placeholders for your institution's list
No activity for 365 days or more before the business date (since opening if never active) and an inflow of 100,000,000 VND or more
rules.when: daysBetween(has(account.lastActivityBeforeToday) ? account.lastActivityBeforeToday : account.openedOn, businessDate) >= 365 && transaction.type in ['CASH_DEPOSIT', 'TRANSFER_IN'] && transaction.amount >= money(100000000, 'VND')

rules.description: Transfer of 200,000,000 VND or more on an account less than 30 days old on the value date
rules.when: daysBetween(account.openedOn, transaction.valueDate) < 30 && transaction.type in ['TRANSFER_IN', 'TRANSFER_OUT'] && transaction.amount >= money(200000000, 'VND')

rules.description: Politically exposed customer moving 500,000,000 VND or more
